root_cause_label: Output Pollution: Spurious Test File Inflates Result Set Beyond Spec
one_sentence_failure_summary: After correctly implementing the Mahjong solver and producing valid results for the 8 original hand files, the agent created a hand_009.json test file inside the live /app input directory and re-ran the script, polluting result.txt with a 9th entry that was never part of the original specification.
t_err_evidence: Step 8: agent writes 'echo ... > /app/hand_009.json', placing a self-verification artifact directly in the production input directory (/app) that the script scans for JSON files.
t_commit_evidence: Step 9: agent re-runs 'python3 /app/solve.py', which now reads hand_009.json alongside the original 8 files, irreversibly producing a 9-entry result.txt.
t_surface_evidence: Step 10: 'cat /app/result.txt' shows 9 lines including 'hand_009.json: { "Winning hand - Standard" }', confirming the output is polluted beyond the expected 8 entries.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the unverified assumption that creating a test JSON file in /app for self-verification would not contaminate the final output. It did not recognize that the production script scans /app for all *.json files, so any file written there becomes part of the output set.
